top_stories.title: Pentagon formalizes Palantir's Maven AI as a core military system with multi-year funding — platform's investment grows to $13 billion from $480 million in 2024. The Pentagon is spending $13.4 billion on AI this year alone.
top_stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Defense has formalized Palantir’s Maven AI as a central military system with a significant multi-year funding commitment. The budget has expanded from $480 million to $13 billion this year, reflecting a major push to embed AI across defense operations.

top_stories.title: Meta is laying off hundreds of employees as it pours money into AI
top_stories.summary: Meta is conducting layoffs affecting hundreds of employees, focusing on positions in tech and engineering, as it reallocates resources to accelerate its investment in AI development. The company is shifting priorities to reinforce its competitiveness in the ongoing AI race.

top_stories.title: Oracle Fusion’s New Agentic AI: Automating the Future of Enterprise Work
top_stories.summary: Oracle has unveiled a new suite of agentic AI tools within its Fusion offering, aimed at automating various enterprise workflows. These AI agents are designed to reason, decide, and act on business tasks, with Oracle highlighting improved productivity and reduced manual effort as core benefits.

top_stories.title: In the Kadrey v. Meta Platforms case, Judge Chabbria's quest to bust the fair use copyright defense to generative AI training rises from the dead!
top_stories.summary: New developments in the Kadrey v. Meta Platforms court case indicate that Judge Chabbria is revisiting the legal contours of fair use in the context of generative AI model training. The outcome may significantly shape IP and copyright law around AI’s use of copyrighted materials.

top_stories.title: Why Not Use AI to Cross the Language Barrier in Academic Publishing?
top_stories.summary: This article discusses the growing adoption of AI-powered translation tools to make academic research more accessible across languages. It evaluates recent advancements, challenges to accuracy, and the potential impact on global knowledge sharing.
